g.text: Floor -0.97 m. Nominal clear height 2.3 m. Room sizes
give the bounding spans in metres.
The finished tug provides the starting point. Its narrow centre passage serves the cabin and galley before feeding the
hold and aft engine room. The cockpit lies forward of room 01. Two of the four modeled passenger pads are active in
